subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Whole-class phonemic awareness oral activities; letter-sound relationships of some single letters (1-2 new letters a week)

show.line: New sounds! p, p, pig. i, i, insect. n, n, net. Let's find them.

rounds.prompt: Which one starts with p, as in pig?
Tap the letter that says n.
Say the sound with me. i, as in insect!
Which one starts with n, as in net?
Which one starts with i, as in insect?
What is this? It starts with p.
Does it start with p or n? Sort the pictures.

hints: Listen for the first sound. p, p, pig.
p pops from your lips. n hums in your nose.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will find a word that starts with n.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Pig starts with p. Net starts with n.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's listen together. n, n, net. Net starts with n!

parent_line: Can hear and recognise the sounds p, i and n.
